desc: Derive and verify the visibility threshold: building i is visible from height h iff h > max_{j<i} (X_i H_j - X_j H_i)/(X_i-X_j); answer is max threshold, 0 if max is 0, -1 if max is negative.

Prove the consecutive-pair reduction by mapping tops to (1/X, H/X), where any non-adjacent slope is a positive weighted average of adjacent slopes, so the maximum threshold is attained by some consecutive pair.
Implement the O(N) adjacent-fraction scan with exact integer cross-multiplication maximum tracking, N=1 handling, and negative/zero sign handling.
Format output correctly (positive as 18-decimal float, -1 for negative, 0.000000000000000000 for zero) and verify all four samples pass.
